A '''business''' operated in [[Daiyu spaceport]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]], in the same building as [[Shipcyr]]. A [[Color|whitish-orange]] sign written in [[Domabesh]], stated the business name, although every letter was mirrored. It read "IS''<small>[obscured character]''</small>REW".<ref name="Kenobi" />
